jobs.description:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and scale our Data Warehouse & Streaming Infra team. You'll own the data platform that Anthropic runs on: the foundation every team relies on to understand the business, make decisions, and keep our systems safe. Every org is your customer. As data volumes grow rapidly, and more of it arrives as real-time streams across multiple clouds, you'll help your team make that stack faster, more robust, and ready for what's next, and you'll shape the long-term vision for how data flows through one of the fastest-growing companies ever.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that calls for both deep technical judgment and strong people skills. You'll partner with leaders across finance, data science, product, engineering, and research to uncover and meet their needs, and you'll grow a small, strong core into a large team. We're looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, energized by both business and technical impact, and cares deeply about people.
Responsibilities
Lead, grow, and mentor the Data Warehouse & Streaming Infra team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and execution at speed
Own Anthropic's data warehousing, streaming, and processing capabilities end-to-end: "wow" user experience, ops, reliability/security/governance/cost, long-term strategic vision
Support the team to scale and evolve our data ingestion, event streaming, change data capture, storage, orchestration, compute, query, and reporting systems at pace with business growth
Collaborate to define and execute the roadmap for Anthropic's batch and streaming data infrastructure, balancing immediate business needs with durable, scalable design
Lead key platform decisions for the streaming backbone, such as managed versus self-operated Kafka, grounded in clear models of throughput, cost, and operational burden
Partner closely across Finance, Product, Research, and Engineering to ensure data systems directly support business-critical decisions and company growth
Drive hiring for the team — sourcing, evaluating, and closing senior data infrastructure engineers who thrive in high-growth, high-trust environments
Establish data quality standards, freshness and delivery SLAs, and operational processes that guide engineers and users through our high-change environment
Ensure sound infrastructure investment decisions with clear awareness of cost, capacity, reliability, and long-term maintainability tradeoffs
Align the broader Infrastructure org on a common direction for shared platforms, tooling, and best practices across Anthropic's data stack
You may be a good fit if you
Have 3+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing data infrastructure teams
Are a people-first leader who gives direct feedback, grows engineers' careers, and builds trust with technical and non-technical partners alike, while staying steady and principled as priorities shift, knowing when to move fast and when to do it right
Bring deep, hands-on expertise in both batch and streaming data infrastructure, from warehousing, pipelines, and orchestration to event streaming and change data capture, including the fundamentals of distributed log systems such as partitioning, delivery guarantees, and backpressure
Have owned systems with significant business or financial impact, and shipped at speed while improving reliability, scalability, security, and cost
Excel at hiring — you've built teams from small to large, and have sharp instincts for identifying exceptional talent
Strong candidates may also have experience with
Warehouse and batch technologies such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Iceberg, Spark, dbt, or Airflow
Streaming and change data capture technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, Flink, or Debezium, ideally including running them at high scale
Multi-cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) or multi-region data platforms, including data-residency requirements
Data infrastructure at AI or ML-intensive companies: you've served customer teams that build pipelines for financial/billing data, model training, evaluation, or safety workflows
Building and operating observability or monitoring for data systems at scale
Working in high-growth environments where data infrastructure had to evolve rapidly to keep pace with the business

Your safety matters to us.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Distribution Transformation - Change Management Lead Are you a transformational leader with a passion for shaping the future of retail banking? As Citizens reimagines its distribution model through the Network Evolution and Xperience Transformation (NEXT) initiative, we are seeking a senior change leader to accelerate enterprise transformation, drive adoption of new operating models, and influence lasting behavioral and cultural change across our branch-centric ecosystem. Our transformation requires leaders who can translate strategy into execution, mobilize organizations to successfully change behavior, and create the conditions for sustained transformation. Position Overview The Distribution Transformation Change Management Lead serves as a strategic partner to business leadership, transformation teams, and field leaders, driving enterprise-scale adoption of key retail transformation initiatives. The role is accountable for developing and executing integrated change strategies that enable successful implementation of future-state distribution models, operating cadences, leadership routines and customer engagement practices. Beyond traditional change management, this leader will shape organizational readiness, influence transformation design decisions, and drive measurable behavior change throughout the distribution network. The role requires deep expertise in organizational transformation, operating model activation, leadership engagement, and change analytics, coupled with the ability to influence senior stakeholders as well as front line colleagues, and align diverse teams around a shared vision. This role serves as enterprise lead for change management across the Distribution transformation and may directly lead internal and external change resources. The successful candidate will establish the frameworks, governance, and measurement disciplines necessary to ensure transformation outcomes are realized and sustained, serving as a key steward of Citizens' modernization journey. Key Responsibilities Strategic Transformation Leadership Lead enterprise change strategy for high-impact distribution transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment between business objectives, organizational readiness, and field execution. Partner with executive sponsors and transformation leaders to identify adoption risks, organizational dependencies, and cultural barriers that could impede successful transformation. Partner with HR, Talent and Business leaders to assess organizational impacts, role evolution and capability requirements associated with transformation initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to other leaders on change readiness, workforce impacts, stakeholder engagement, and transformation effectiveness. Influence transformation design decisions by representing colleague, customer, and field perspectives throughout program planning and execution. Organizational Adoption & Operating Model Activation Translate future-state distribution and operating model strategies into comprehensive adoption roadmaps spanning organizational structure, roles and capabilities. Design and implement scalable approaches that drive adoption, proficiency, and sustainment across a geographically dispersed retail organization. Ensure new ways of working are embedded into daily operations, leadership routines, talent processes, and performance expectations. Leadership & Stakeholder Mobilization Partner with distribution leadership teams to build visible sponsorship, accountability, and ownership of transformation outcomes. Establish leadership activation strategies that equip leaders to model desired behaviors and reinforce transformation objectives. Build alignment among cross-functional stakeholders, fostering shared ownership for adoption and business outcomes. Innovation, Experimentation & Continuous Improvement Lead test-and-learn methodologies, including micro-testing and pilots, to accelerate adoption and reduce implementation risk. Establish mechanisms for continuous listening, feedback collection, and organizational sensing to inform real-time adjustments to transformation strategies. Drive a culture of learning and agility by incorporating field insights into transformation design and execution. Measurement & Value Realization Define and oversee a comprehensive change measurement framework, including organizational readiness, adoption, behavioral, proficiency, and business outcome metrics. Partner with Data and Analytics teams to quantify adoption trends, identify gaps, and proactively address areas of resistance. Monitor progress against transformation objectives and provide executive-level reporting and recommendations to ensure successful value realization. Sustainment & Culture Transformation Develop long-term sustainment strategies that reinforce behavioral shifts and ensure enduring business impact beyond formal transformation programs. Champion cultural evolution efforts that strengthen adaptability, accountability, collaboration, and customer-centric behaviors across the distribution network. Establish governance mechanisms that support continued optimization and evolution of transformed operating models. Qualifications - Required 10+ years of experience leading large-scale organizational transformation, change management, operating model activation, or business transformation initiatives. Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to drive enterprise-wide adoption of strategic business initiatives. Significant experience leading organizational and behavioral change across complex, multi-location, customer-facing organizations and customer-facing colleagues. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority. Experience establishing change measurement frameworks that connect adoption outcomes to business performance. Strong executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Experience within retail banking or distribution organizations, or experience within deep customer experience industries. Experience supporting branch network transformation, workforce transformation, or distribution strategy initiatives. Demonstrated expertise in behavioral science, adoption strategy, design thinking, continuous improvement, or test-and-learn methodologies. jobs.description: The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) team at Amazon Ads is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that help tens of millions of advertisers understand the value of their ad spend while prioritizing customer privacy and measurement quality. The Media Planning Science team, part of broader MADS team, develops and implements models that deliver insights and recommendations for strategic media planning and measurement across Amazon Advertising's product portfolio. Our mission is to help advertisers create and execute plans that meet their objectives while providing accurate measurement tools. We work on a multitude of problem statements that encompass Reach and Frequency, Budget Planning Optimization, and Recommendations. Our models leverage both heuristic and machine learning approaches including deep learning techniques, with insights delivered through agent-based tools and APIs that integrate seamlessly into user interfaces and programmatic systems to ensure optimal advertising outcomes. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, DL, NLP, Gen AI, and Causal Inference with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, sales leaders, and other scientists with expertise in the ads industry and on building scalable modeling and software solutions.

jobs.description: Are you someone who looks at a process and immediately sees what could be automated, documented better, or removed entirely? The Program Management and Coordination team within AWS Infrastructure Services is growing to support an expanding portfolio of data centre sites across Asia-Pacific, and we are looking for a Controls Coordinator to own the transactional backbone of controls delivery across APAC. You will manage every work order, change order, purchase request, purchase order, and capital appropriation request end to end against published SLAs, partnering with Controls Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Procurement to turn engineering decisions into committed spend. The timing matters. The team is part-way through automating its own transactional work, so you will help design that tooling rather than inherit it finished. Vendor management is also becoming a defined programme rather than something each coordinator handles independently, giving you a clear area to own from the start. No data centre experience is needed. What matters is what you do with a process once you hold it: writing the run book a new joiner can follow without asking, building the report that answers the question before it gets asked, and automating the parts that should never have been manual. Key job responsibilities - Manage every work order, change order, purchase request, purchase order, and capital appropriation request end to end, tracking each against its published SLA and escalating exceptions early with a recommendation attached. - Coordinate with Controls Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Procurement across APAC to land commitments that carry real money, including support for annual and mid-year operating plans. - Design and maintain run books and process documentation so that workflows survive your absence and can be followed by any team member without additional guidance. - Build reporting and automation that removes routine processing from people, using AI tools where they add value, and measure the before-and-after impact of every improvement you deliver. - Own the vendor management programme for your region, defining consistent processes and partnering with global counterparts across a follow-the-sun operating model. A day in the life Your morning starts with your queue: the requests are yours from day one, and so are the blockers behind them. You might spend the first hour clearing purchase orders through their approval chain, then shift to refining an automation that shaves a manual step off the change-order workflow. After a standup with your Controls Engineering partners, you review an open vendor issue with Procurement and draft the escalation note. Later you pull together the data for a business review that senior leadership will read directly. Between tasks you are testing a new AI-driven dashboard the team is building in-house. By the end of the day you have moved work forward, removed a friction point, and documented what you changed so the next person does not have to ask. This is where process gets designed rather than requested. The team is eight people today, spread across Tokyo, Singapore, Sydney, and Melbourne, and everyone sits within the same Tech Ops Engineering job family — meaning the step from coordinator to programme manager is a genuine progression on a single ladder. Our closest partners are the Controls Engineers running deployments, projects, service, and colocation across APAC, along with Finance, Legal, and Procurement on every commitment that carries money. We also collaborate with our counterparts in the Americas and EMEA through a global follow-the-sun model, so a process you improve once is improved everywhere we operate.

jobs.description: AWS is hiring a Community Engagement Manager to lead community first initiatives to drive positive impact and brand reputation. This position will be based out of Charlotte and will support the business across North Carolina. This is a strategic role that requires the right candidate to Dive Deep to understand and support the AWS business. As a Community Engagement Manager, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert on external issues management and community relations around Data Center Infrastructure. You will identify and collaborate with partner organizations and key stakeholders to understand community needs, build relationships, and drive impactful outcomes. You will own the region's community issues management and lead the identification and deployment of programs designed to deliver sustaining and lasting impact in the communities where we live and work. The AWS InCommunities team launches long-term, innovative programs that drive lasting impact in regions around the world. We are obsessed with being good neighbors — we start with the community and work backwards to represent infrastructure communities inside AWS. Key job responsibilities -Build and maintain trusted relationships with community stakeholders, including residents, civic leaders, elected officials, nonprofit partners, and local organizations. -Lead strategy development and execution of community engagement plans for major development projects across the region. -Manage community investments and partnerships, ensuring alignment with Amazon's community pillars and measurable local impact. -Design and execute signature events and programs, and set the vision for sustainable community engagement initiatives with a high bar for quality. -Own internal and external communications for community engagement programs and represent Amazon publicly across multiple channels. -Serve as the point of contact for community centric issues, proactively identifying and addressing concerns that pose reputational risk to Amazon. -Lead community assessments for new sites, identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and scale programming as the business grows. -Capture and report data demonstrating the quantified and qualified impact of community engagement, and communicate results internally and externally. -Partner with cross functional teams including engineering, operations, real estate, energy, water, sustainability, construction, legal, public policy, and public relations. -Be physically present in the community and get work done on the ground when required. A day in the life No two days look alike in this role. You might start by reviewing developments across your data center sites, then meet with nonprofit leaders to shape a new investment before aligning with internal partners on messaging for a community milestone. You partner cross functionally with engineering, operations, real estate, energy, water, sustainability, construction, legal, public policy, and communications teams. Your customers are the communities where Amazon operates, including residents, civic leaders, elected officials, and nonprofit partners. The core problem you solve is ensuring Amazon is a trusted neighbor by proactively identifying community risks and delivering programs with measurable impact. About the team AWS InCommunities invests in the communities where Amazon operates — funding infrastructure, education, and workforce development programs that create lasting impact. Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

jobs.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals. You will focus on the Life Sciences vertical, partnering with pharmaceutical companies, clinical research organizations, and other data and services providers to deploy next-generation AI capabilities across their drug discovery, development, and operations. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with Life Sciences customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities. Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures). This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Who We Are
2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.
Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K, renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!
What We Need
The PGA TOUR 2K Integrated Marketing team is looking for a Manager, Product Marketing. We are responsible for building data-driven marketing strategies that reach and engage fans with value-rich experiences that drive revenue growth, brand health, and loyalty. We aim to connect fans around the world to the most engaging golf platform: our franchise.
As a Manager, Product Marketing, you will be responsible for helping deliver full-funnel marketing campaigns, in partnership with internal and external partners, to drive player satisfaction and commercial success. From Seasonal Live-Service executions, to multi-faceted partnership campaigns, to targeted in-game promotions, you will ideate on product feature messaging and strategies, lead in-game creative development, oversee tactical execution plans, and leverage new and emerging technologies to best serve our players. This is a role that never stands still, and where no two days are the same.
To be successful in this role, you will need to be a true product marketing expert that understands every facet of our game and how they serve our current and prospective players. Within the integrated marketing team, it is your responsibility to be the product’s source of truth to help inform go-to-market strategies through a strong, collaborative mindset and data-driven insight. An existing passion for, or a willingness to learn about, the sport of golf is key: the PGA TOUR 2K franchise is the most authentic representation of the sport, and success in this role is determined by our ability to demonstrate that to our players.
What You Will Do
Manage comprehensive end-to-end marketing campaigns across our full live-services machine. From title-level level marketing planning, to Seasonal creative executions, to Free-to-Play activations, to real-life sporting event tie-ins. You will often manage multiple campaigns concurrently.
Authentically represent player needs by knowing our game in and out, through a deep understanding and appreciation for player insights and analytics, as well as time spent in the game testing out features and flows to best represent ways we highlight product value and live services content.
Own our in-game lifecycle strategy: architecting messaging and offer constructs that move our players through the optimal player experience. Leverage campaign learnings and insights to optimize evergreen messaging and intervention timings.
Lead and execute high-profile brand partnerships, influencer tie-ins, and promotional activations; you will work with internal Partnerships and Product teams to help establish how our licensed partners come to life in-game, then build marketing campaigns to drive awareness and engagement with their branded content.
Build and maintain high-trust relationships across our Business Unit and our shared service teams to ensure zero friction in the execution of integrated global campaigns.
What Will Make You A Great Fit
Product Passion & Literacy:
You're as comfortable in a product roadmap conversation as a campaign brief kick off call. You know how to establish, define and represent marketing priorities to influence product decisions and create content that authentically resonates with our players.
Operational Rigor:
You can hold multiple campaigns, live and upcoming, in harmony without losing precision on any one of them—meeting internal and external deadlines to execute flawlessly.
Content & Channel Fluency:
You can partner with multiple cross-functional teams to orchestrate a multi-touchpoint tactical execution, understanding the nuance between owned, earned and paid channels to maximise acquisition and engagement.
Partnership & Licensing Acumen:
You know how to run activations that integrate licenses, licensors and/or talent from concept through to legal sign-off, balancing creative ambition with third-party and IP priorities and obligations.
Cross-Functional Influence:
You build trust quickly with key stakeholders across the Business Unit, shared services teams, and our development studio. You will operate as the connective tissue that keeps teams moving in the same direction towards execution.
Qualifications
Proven experience in product marketing, live-service campaign management, or lifecycle marketing experience within gaming or digital entertainment.
Extensive knowledge or interest in sports verticals, ideally golf.
Passion to deliver thoughtfully integrated campaigns players can resonate with, that showcase the product as a means to drive awareness, acquisition and retention.
Deep understanding of how to measure and report on marketing performance across owned and operated, earned, and paid channels.
Strong ability to interpret data and learnings to influence real-time decision making.
Familiarity with PC & console gaming marketing (PlayStation, Xbox. Steam) a plus.
